title: НА + prepositional: This week, last week

blocks.text: НА + Prepositional indicates the week during which an event takes place.

items: the other day; within a few days

items.text: The preposition НА + Prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place.
Note also the expression „на (этих) днях“. When referred to the past „на днях“ means „a few days ago“, „the other day“… When referred to the future, it means „within a few days“.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Том въезжает вместе с Джоном на ___ (следующая неделя).
exercises.prompt: Tom is moving in with John next week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделе** (prep. sg.). На + prepositional: the week in which something happens. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.  **следующий → следующей** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with неделе). Declines like хороший. Ending -ая → -ей.

exercises.prompt: I'll have to take a make-up test in English next week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделе** (prep. sg.). На + prepositional: the week in which something happens. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.  **следующий → следующей** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with неделе). Declines like хороший. Ending -ая → -ей.

exercises.q: На ___ (прошлая неделя), я написал товарищу Вуду и попросил его пристроить тебя на ферме.
exercises.prompt: I wrote to Mr. Wood last week and asked him to give you a job on the farm.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделе** (prep. sg.). На + prepositional: the week in which something happens. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.  **прошлый → прошлой** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with неделе). Declines like новый. Ending -ая → -ой.

exercises.q: На ___ (прошлая неделя) Том отметил своё двадцатилетие.
exercises.prompt: Tom celebrated his twentieth birthday last week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделе** (prep. sg.). На + prepositional: the week in which something happens. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.  **прошлый → прошлой** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with неделе). Declines like новый. Ending -ая → -ой.

**неделя → неделе** (prep. sg.). На + prepositional: the week in which something happens. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.  **тот → той** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with неделе). «тот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern).

exercises.q: Ну, сударь, невзлюбил я его с этой поры, то есть на ___ (первые дни) возненавидел.
exercises.why: **день → днях** (prep. pl.: на + prepositional). Declines like автомобиль. Ending -ь → -ях, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -ях.  **первый → первых** (prep. pl., agreeing with днях). Declines like новый. Ending -ые → -ых.
